name: MCP server
summary: Expose Postgres-backed tools to an AI agent over MCP

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon. The tools query it and the tool-call log is written here.

env.name: MCP_SERVER_NAME
env.description: Server name reported in the MCP initialize handshake.

env.name: MCP_API_KEY
env.description: Optional shared secret. When set, every request must send 'Authorization: Bearer <this value>'. An MCP endpoint has a public URL, so leaving this unset exposes the tools to anyone who finds it.

operations.title: POST /mcp
operations.description: HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0) — the MCP endpoint: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping
